analysts.as: AI-driven SOC solutions destabilize operational norms

expert.text: By 2030, preemptive cybersecurity solutions will account for 50% of IT security spending, up from less than 5% in 2024.
Vulnerability exploitation caused 20% of breaches; only 54% of edge-device vulnerabilities were fully fixed, taking a median 32 days.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Agree maintenance rules that allow 24-hour emergency patching of edge and identity systems.
lens.ciso: Rank fixes by exposure and active exploitation, and give edge devices a 24-hour patch path.
lens.cto: Plan for far more patches; AI has made finding software flaws cheap and fast.
lens.eng: Automate patch testing and rollout so critical fixes ship within a day.

line: AI now finds and weaponises software flaws within hours. Defence has to move first.
scope: Patching and defence at AI speed, for all systems. Not attacks on AI itself.
